transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess just... things at work. Dispatch and compliance, they've been... tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. 

People keep saying it’s just normal oversight, but... I hear the little comments on the radio. I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you think these people are actually talking about you on the radio?

Yeah. ... I mean, I know what I hear. 

They don't always use my name, but... it's about my routes. The computer system tracks it, and then they make those little comments. Everyone tries to tell me it's just normal oversight, but... I can just tell they're reporting on me.
Have you ever had a time when you didn't think people were reporting on you?

Um... yeah, I guess. It wasn't always like this. 

Just... the tracking on the computer, and the stuff on the radio... it's been pretty clear to me for about the past two months. Before that... I don't know, it was fine, I guess. But the last two months, yeah.
Do you still hear those comments on the radio when you're not at work?
No. Just at work.
Do you still think people are reporting on you when you're not at work and not hearing those comments on the radio?

Um... yeah. I mean... dispatch and compliance, they track my route changes through the computer system. So even if I'm at home... I know certain drivers are still reporting on me to them. 

People keep saying it's just normal oversight, but... I can just tell they're doing it.
Do you ever have times when you don't think people are reporting on you, even if it's just for a short while?

No, not really. I mean... like I said, I know they're tracking me. The computer system, dispatch, compliance... it doesn't just stop. Even if people say it's normal oversight, I know what's happening. The other drivers are still reporting on me. It's just... it's always there.
Do you think people are reporting on you to anyone else outside of work, like friends or family?
Um... no. I don't think so. Just... just the people at work.
Have you ever thought that maybe you're misinterpreting the comments on the radio or the tracking on the computer system?

I don't think so. I mean... I know what I'm hearing. The little comments on the radio... the way they track my route changes through the computer... it's not just normal oversight. I can tell. Certain drivers are definitely reporting on me to dispatch and compliance. I'm not... I'm not misunderstanding it.
Have your thoughts about people reporting on you ever changed or wavered since you first started noticing them two months ago?

No. Not really. Um... like I already told you, it's just been the same. The way dispatch tracks my route changes on the computer... the radio comments. It hasn't stopped or anything. People keep saying it's just normal oversight, but... I know those drivers are reporting on me. It hasn't changed.
Have you ever had a moment, even if just for a second, where you doubted that people were actually reporting on you?

No. I... I don't. Even when people try to tell me it's just normal oversight, I... I don't doubt it. Because I see the computer tracking. I hear the radio. I can just tell the drivers are reporting on me to compliance. So... no.
Have you ever had any other thoughts like this, where you're completely sure something is happening, but others tell you it's not?
No. Just... just what I've told you. Nothing else.
Have you ever thought that anyone else, besides those at work, is out to get you or harm you in some way?
No. Just... just at work. Nobody else.
Have you ever had any other thoughts where you felt like someone or something was out to get you, besides the people at work?
No. I... I think I just answered that. It's only work. Nobody else.
Has your belief that people are reporting on you ever changed in intensity or feeling since it started two months ago?
No. I don't... I don't think so. It's just been the same.
Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions, like seeing things that others don't, since you started noticing people reporting on you?
No. I... I don't see things. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you ever thought that anyone or anything is trying to harm you or sabotage you outside of the context of your job?
I... I already said no. It's just at work. I don't... I don't know why you keep asking the same thing.
Have you ever felt like someone is out to get you in a situation that doesn't involve your job or work?
I just told you. No. It's only at work. I don't have anything else to add to that.
Have you ever thought that anyone is out to get you in a situation that doesn't involve your job or work?
Are you... are you even listening to me? I don't... I don't know what else you want me to say. The answer is still no.
Has your belief that people are reporting on you at work ever stopped, even for a day?

No. It doesn't stop. ...Dispatch and compliance are always tracking my route changes through the computer system. There's always little comments on the radio. People try to say it's just normal oversight, but... I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me. So, no.
